reports.summary: Crude above $90, geopolitical uncertainty and weak global cues pressure sentiment, while institutional buying and strong Indian earnings provide a cushion.
drivers: Higher crude raises India's import bill and can pressure INR, inflation and fuel-sensitive sectors.
Higher Treasury yields and weaker global risk appetite can weigh on Indian equities.
Institutional buying can absorb some selling pressure.
news: Higher crude keeps import-bill and inflation risks elevated.
Treasury yields and global risk appetite remain important.
Institutional flows may cushion intraday selling.
learning: Higher oil can increase the import bill, pressure the rupee and raise inflation expectations.
Institutional flows can amplify or absorb index pressure; persistence matters more than one day's number.
history: Crude above $90; global cues weak; institutional buying offers a cushion.
